
name: Generate Feature Commit Title

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened, synchronize]
    branches:
      - base-v2

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  generate-title:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Generate the next feature title
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
            const baseBranch = "base-v2";

            // Only handle feature branches targeting base-v2.
            if (pr.base.ref !== baseBranch) {
              core.setFailed("Unexpected target branch.");
              return;
            }

            // Extract the Jira ID from the branch name.
            const match = pr.head.ref.match(
              /^(?:feature|bugfix)\/(GSIS-\d+)(?:-|$)/
            );

            if (!match) {
              core.setFailed(
                "Branch must start with feature/GSIS-12345 or bugfix/GSIS-12345."
              );
              return;
            }

            const jiraId = match[1];
            let page = 1;
            let highest = 0;
            let foundBase = false;

            // Read the target branch history and find the
            // highest feature number for this Jira story.
            while (page <= 100) {
              const result = await github.rest.repos.listCommits({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                sha: baseBranch,
                per_page: 100,
                page
              });

              if (result.data.length === 0) break;

              for (const commit of result.data) {
                const message = commit.commit.message;
                const title = message.split("\n")[0].trim();

                if (title === `${jiraId}-F1`) {
                  foundBase = true;
                }

                const escapedId = jiraId.replace(
                  /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&"
                );
                const re = new RegExp(
                  `^${escapedId}-F(\\d+)$`
                );
                const m = title.match(re);

                if (m) {
                  highest = Math.max(highest, Number(m[1]));
                }
              }

              if (result.data.length < 100) break;
              page++;
            }

            if (page > 100) {
              core.setFailed(
                "History scan limit reached; verify the feature number manually."
              );
              return;
            }

            const nextTitle = `${jiraId}-F${highest + 1}`;

            // Update the PR title, which will be used as
            // the squash commit title by repository settings.
            if (pr.title !== nextTitle) {
              await github.rest.pulls.update({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                pull_number: pr.number,
                title: nextTitle
              });
            }

            core.notice(`Feature title set to ${nextTitle}`);
